macros.name: AtEveryStanza

macros.name: AtEveryStanza*
macros.doc: Use \AtEveryStanza{⟨arg⟩} to automatically add content before stanzas (not in the same paragraph).

macros.name: AtEveryStopStanza
macros.doc: Use \AtEveryStopStanza to automatically add content after the end of stanzas (not in the same paragraph).

macros.name: AtEveryStopStanza*

macros.name: BeforeEveryStopStanza

macros.doc: \doendnotes is the command you use to print one series of endnotes; it takes one argument: the series letter of the note series you want to print.

macros.name: doinsidelinehook
macros.doc: \doinsidelinehook{⟨arg⟩} will be executed before printing a new line, when the line number has already been fixed.

macros.name: doinsidethislinehook
macros.doc: The \doinsidethislinehook{⟨code⟩} macro allows ⟨code⟩ to be executed when the text is typeset.

macros.name: dolinehook
macros.doc: The argument passed to \dolinehook{⟨arg⟩} will be executed before slicing a new line in the paragraph.

macros.name: edbeforetab
macros.doc: The macro \edbeforetab{⟨text⟩}{⟨math⟩} puts ⟨text⟩ at the left margin before \edaftertab array cell entry ⟨math⟩.

macros.name: edindex
macros.doc: The \edindex{⟨item⟩} macro can be used in numbered text to specify that ⟨item⟩ and the current page & linenumber should be added to the raw index file.

macros.name: edlabelE

macros.name: edlabelS
macros.doc: Use \edlabelS{⟨label⟩} to mark the start line of the passage.

macros.name: edlabelSE
macros.doc: Use \edlabelSE{⟨label⟩} to mark just one location in the text.

macros.name: edpageref
macros.doc: If the specified label exists, \edpageref gives its page number.

macros.name: edrowfill
macros.doc: The macro \edrowfill{⟨start⟩}{⟨end⟩}{⟨fill⟩} fills columns number ⟨start⟩ to ⟨end⟩ inclusive with ⟨fill⟩.

macros.name: edtext

macros.name: edvertdots

macros.name: edvertline
macros.doc: The macro \edvertline{⟨height⟩} draws a vertical line ⟨height⟩ high (contrast this with \edatright where the size argument is half the desired height).

macros.name: endlock

macros.name: endnumbering

macros.name: endsub
macros.doc: \startsub and \endsub turn sub-lineation on and off, by writing appropriate instructions to the line-list file.

macros.name: firstlinenum
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: flagstanza
macros.doc: Putting \flagstanza[⟨len⟩]{⟨text⟩} at the start of a line in a stanza (or elsewhere) will typeset ⟨text⟩ at a distance ⟨len⟩ before the line.

macros.name: flagstanza

macros.name: footfootmarkA

macros.name: ledinnernote
macros.doc: \ledinnernote{⟨text⟩} will put ⟨text⟩ into the inner margin level with where the command was issued.

macros.name: ledlsnotesep
macros.doc: The texts are put a distance \ledlsnotesep (or \ledrsnotesep) into the left (or right) margin.

macros.name: ledlsnotewidth
macros.doc: The left sidenote text is put into a box of width \ledlsnotewidth and the right text into a box of width \ledrsnotewidth.

macros.name: lednopb
macros.doc: \lednopb prevents a page break, by adding one line to the current page if needed.

macros.name: lednopbinversetrue
macros.doc: If you want to prevent page breaks inside long verses, use the option nopbinverse when loading package, or use \lednopbinversetrue.

macros.name: ledpb
macros.doc: \ledpb adds a page break.

macros.name: ledrightnote

macros.name: ledrsnotesep
macros.doc: The texts are put a distance \ledlsnotesep (or \ledrsnotesep) into the left (or right) margin.

macros.name: ledrsnotewidth
macros.doc: The left sidenote text is put into a box of width \ledlsnotewidth and the right text into a box of width \ledrsnotewidth.

macros.name: ledsidenote
macros.doc: \ledsidenote{⟨text⟩} is the command for a moveable sidenote.

macros.name: leftlinenum

macros.name: lineannot

macros.name: lineation
macros.doc: Lines can be numbered either by page, by pstart or by section; you specify this using the \lineation{⟨arg⟩} macro, where ⟨arg⟩ is either page, pstart or section.

macros.name: linenum
macros.doc: You can use \linenum{⟨arg⟩} to change the line numbers passed to the notes.

macros.name: linenumannotation
macros.doc: The \linenumannotation allows users to add manual annotations to line numbers, for example to refer to line numbers from an older edition.

macros.name: linenumannotationothersidetrue
macros.doc: With the \linenumannotationothersidetrue, the annotation will appear on the margin side opposite to the line number.

macros.name: linenumberlist
macros.doc: You can define \linenumberlist to specify a non-uniform distribution of printed line numbers.

macros.name: linenumberstyle

macros.name: linenumincrement
macros.doc: \firstlinenum specifies the first line that will have a printed number, and \linenumincrement is the difference between successive numbered lines.

macros.name: linenummargin
macros.doc: \linenummargin{⟨word⟩} specify which margin line numbers are in; it takes one argument, a string, which value can be left ; right; inner or outer.

macros.name: linenumsep
macros.doc: You will generally want a kern between a line number and the text, and \linenumsep is provided as a standard way of storing its size.

macros.name: lockdisp
macros.doc: When line locking is being used, the \lockdisp{⟨word⟩} macro specifies whether a line number—if one is due to appear—should be printed on the first printed line or on the last, or by all of them.

macros.name: msdata

macros.name: newseries
